Name: (CP) Nyapu Style Portrait for Constance (The Fishmonger - Custom NPC Mod)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

After many hours of work my Nyapu styled portrait for Constance from the fishmonger mod is complete!

This portrait mod includes Constance's everyday and festival portraits so you're not missing out on anything :)

I used a couple of assets from Nyapu's mods as a base but created & coloured a lot of the outfits myself.


Let me know if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:

[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip the Nyapu style portrait for Constance mod in your Mods folder

[*]You're all done! Now you can play your modded stardew save with a matching nyapu portrait for the lovely Constance.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

Added compatibility with younger Willy portraits with a matching style for his sibling Constance! A younger Nyapu style Willy is currently in the works :)


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]

Thank you so so much [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/163267158]VoidWitchCult[/url] for giving me permission to create and release this mod! Checkout the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16326]Main Mod[/url]﻿!
[/list]
I can't thank [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/mods?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]﻿ enough for open asset use permissions in order to make this mod possible: Checkout out their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Portraits[/url]﻿!


Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
